data.title: AI Engineer Analyst INTERNSHIP
data.description: Join a cutting-edge AI team as an intern! Work on Language Models, multimodal AI, and responsible AI standards. Gain hands-on experience with Python, cloud, and GenAI APIs. Perfect for passionate students eager to innovate in Generative AI. Apply now ! Location : Paris 17e (hybrid). Duration : 6 months, full-time. Start date : July 2026. About the job Context AXA GO – GDAI is seeking a motivated AI Engineer intern to join the GenAI team and work on cutting-edge projects involving Language Models (LLMs & SLMs) and multimodal models. Main missions Deploy, evaluate, and compare LLMs, SLMs, and multimodal models on quality, latency, cost, and safety. Create and maintain model cards aligned with AXA Responsible AI standards. Write clean, reusable Python code and documentation; share results clearly with the team. Collaborate closely with engineers and researchers; communicate progress regularly. Expected skills & experience We are looking for someone with the following experience and skills: Technical Skills Proficient in Python Experience with Git and cloud environments (Azure preferred). First hands-on experience with GenAI models/APIs (open-source or hosted). Familiarity with basic ML/NLP concepts Bonus: Docker/containers, CI/CD Soft skills / transversal skills Structured and organized Good culture and curiosity on AI topics and applications Fluency in English, communication and collaboration skills are required. Ability to work independently and take initiative. Education Master’s (ongoing or recently graduated) in Computer Science, Data Science, or AI, with strong interest in Generative AI and Agentic AI. Where will you be in the organization? The division The department / team What we offer We bring together the expertise, cultural diversity and creativity of over 8,000 employees worldwide and we’re committed to equal opportunities in all aspects of employment (gender, LGBT+, disabled persons, or people of different origins) and to promoting Diversity & Inclusion by creating a work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect, and where individual differences are valued. About the entity AXA is becoming a sustainable tech-led company and at AXA Group Operations we are one of the major catalysts for this transformation. We set the tone by triggering and empowering the evolution of our insurance business model through technology and innovation, driving its concrete implementation globally at speed, with a high quality of advisory and execution. We are present across 17 countries with committed, highly qualified teams. We leverage technology, data, sourcing, security and investment allocation in a global way, but also achieve economies of scale and synergies when necessary. At AXA Group Operations, we want to be recognized in three fields of action: State-of-the-art Data Technology to drive customer experience State-of-the-art Procurement & Sourcing to drive efficiency and better manage risks High-Performing Global Team for stronger partnerships with AXA entities About AXA As a world-leading insurance company, we act for human progress by protecting what matters. With 153,000 employees in 54 countries working for 105 million customers, we’ve created a truly dynamic and vibrant community. Inclusion and diversity link closely with our values, and together we’re nurturing a culture of respect, for each other, for our customers and the communities around us. Join AXA and you’ll feel like you belong, are included and can thrive. You’ll be able to shape the way you work and truly grow your potential as you seek out new opportunities, push boundaries and benefit people in critical moments of their lives. This is your chance to build the tomorrow you want. Know you can.

data.title: AI Engineer Analyst/ Apprentice
data.description: VOTRE FUTUR TERRAIN D’EXPRESSION La raison d’être d’AXA est d’« Agir pour le progrès humain en protégeant ce qui compte ». La protection a toujours été au cœur de nos activités, en aidant les individus, les entreprises et les sociétés à prospérer. Et AXA a toujours été un leader, un innovateur, une société entrepreneuriale, favorisant le progrès dans toutes ses dimensions. La mission de notre entité, AXA Group Operations (AXA GO), est de soutenir et responsabiliser l’ensemble des équipes d’AXA afin de concrétiser cette ambition commune. L’innovation et l’exécution sont nos principaux leviers pour atteindre cet objectif. Ils guident l’ensemble des équipes de GO au quotidien : Innovation : créer et fournir les bases et opportunités aux équipes d’AXA qui développeront des solutions innovantes afin de répondre aux besoins de nos clients actuels et futurs ; Exécution : créer l’environnement qui permettra à nos équipes à travers le monde, de donner vie à leurs idées et de tenir les promesses faites à nos clients. Nos objectifs concrets sont de : Renforcer la création de valeur pour l’ensemble du groupe AXA ; Soutenir et encourager l'innovation au sein d'AXA, en collaboration avec la division Group Business Innovation ; Automatiser et intégrer la simplicité dans notre travail quotidien, en nous assurant de contribuer efficacement à la mission et stratégie d’AXA. Les équipes d’AXA Group Operations sont composées de : Group IT Services et Group CIO : définissent la stratégie IT globale d’AXA ; favorisent la convergence de l’IT au sein des entités et leur fournissent des services partagés ; Group Security : protège les salariés, nos parties prenantes et la marque AXA en sécurisant les informations et gérant la cyber sécurité, la sécurité physique ainsi que la résilience des opérations ; Group Data and AI Innovation : définie les ambitions concernant la maturité des données du Groupe ; construit et gère la communauté ; conduit la recherche et l’expertise ; assiste les entités les moins matures en termes de données ; identifie les technologies de pointe et en développe des disruptives pour les entités ; crée des cas d’usage sur des technologies spécifiques avec les entités ; Group Procurement and Sourcing : définie la stratégie d’achats d’AXA, ses lignes directrices et les normes du Groupe ; gère les relations avec nos fournisseurs stratégiques et accélère les achats métiers ; GO Strategy/Finance & Group SPM : s’assure de la cohérence des projets globaux avec la stratégie du Groupe ; veille à la mise en œuvre et performance des projets stratégiques ; GO General Secretary & Risk : définit le framework de management du risk et s’assure de sa bonne intégration dans la conception de nos produits et procédures afin de favoriser la prise de décision dans un environnement plus sécurisé. GO Transformation : accélère la transformation agile au sein de Group Operations ; établit et met en œuvre une communication et stratégie RH commune à notre division. AXA Business Services : offre des services partagés alignés aux priorités commerciales d’AXA. VOTRE FUTURE CONTRIBUTION Dans ce contexte, vous intégrerez le département Group Data and AI Innovation et plus particulièrement le Software and AI Engineering Rattaché(e) David Graça en charge de la Developer Experience, vous aurez pour missions principales de : Creation de logiciel informatique Web Aider à l'intégration d'outils et de méthodologies basés sur l'IA tout au long des phases du SDLC, y compris la planification, le développement, les tests, le déploiement et la maintenance. Contribuer à l'automatisation des processus de test et améliorer la qualité des logiciels à l'aide de techniques d'IA. Participer à l'animation de la communauté des développeurs et contribuer à l'expérience développeur au sein d'AXA. Aider à l'organisation et à la participation à des événements liés à la technologie et à l'innovation. Collaborer avec des équipes variées pour recueillir des exigences et fournir des informations qui favorisent le succès des projets. Participer à l'analyse des données pour identifier des tendances et améliorer les flux de travail au sein du processus de développement logiciel. …Vous développerez : Une vision globale de l’entreprise et vous serez en contact avec plusieurs intervenants distribués dans le monde Une organisation de travail rythmé et efficace Vos capacités informatiques dans le domaine du IA,CI/CD, Cloud, sécurité IT, développement web, création de contenu pour présentations VOTRE BACKGROUND …Vous aimez : Web, Bash, OpenAI, Développement informatique, Cloud AWS/Azure, Open Source, Communautés IT, sécurité IT, exposer vos idées et faire comprendre votre point de vue. Formation : Ecole d’Ingénieur ou Université en de niveau Bac+3 à Bac+5) Ecole(s) cible(s) : Catholique, ParisTech, Télécom, Grenoble INP Spécialisation : Informatique ou équivalent Rythme d’alternance idéal : semaine complete Rythme d’alternance à éviter : jours pas consecutifs, par example lundi, mardi et vendredi. Moins de 3 jours par semaine Compétences comportementales / Soft skills : Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais ; la maîtrise du français est un plus. Capacité à travailler en collaboration dans un environnement d'équipe diversifié. Fort désir d'apprendre et de s'adapter aux nouvelles technologies. Capacité de réflexion critique et de résolution de problèmes. Avoir envie d’une experience à l’international Compétences techniques / Hard skills : Développement Web, Back et Front Integration de API de LLM’s et AI Coding Java, Python, C#, JS ou autre (une des options) Sécurité applicative (notions) Cloud AWS ou Azure (optionnel) Open Source (optionnel) Langues : Anglais bon niveau, Français bilingue Outils informatiques : Office 365 ; Github Cloud AWS ou Azure Outils de développement logiciel informatique REJOIGNEZ-NOUS, LANCEZ-VOUS OU BIEN PARTAGEZ Depuis toujours, AXA mène une politique de recrutement engagée auprès des jeunes. Avec l’alternance, nous offrons aux étudiants une véritable opportunité d’insertion professionnelle. L’alternance nous permet aussi de bénéficier d’une vision extérieure, neuve et critique, sur nos méthodes de travail, nos outils, nos modes de communication. Nos alternants partagent la vie d’une équipe et font l’expérience de la vie professionnelle. Ils s’inscrivent ainsi dans un parcours d’acquisition de compétences. Les talents détectés parmi eux constituent d’ailleurs un vivier de recrutement pour nos offres de CDI et de CDD. Nos différences sont nos atouts. Chez AXA en France, ce sont plus de 76 nationalités qui travaillent ensemble, sur des métiers divers et variés. Et c’est ce qui fait notre force ! C’est pourquoi nous cherchons à promouvoir l’égalité et la diversité à tous les niveaux (mixité, handicap, orientation sexu

data.title: Data Analyst Apprentice
data.description: About AXA As a world-leading insurance company, we act for human progress by protecting what matters. With 153,000 employees in 54 countries working for 105 million customers, we’ve created a truly dynamic and vibrant community. Inclusion and diversity link closely with our values, and together we’re nurturing a culture of respect, for each other, for our customers and the communities around us. Join AXA and you’ll feel like you belong, are included and can thrive. You’ll be able to shape the way you work and truly grow your potential as you seek out new opportunities, push boundaries and benefit people in critical moments of their lives. This is your chance to build the tomorrow you want. Know you can. About the entity AXA is becoming a sustainable tech-led company and at AXA Group Operations we are one of the major catalysts for this transformation. We set the tone by triggering and empowering the evolution of our insurance business model through technology and innovation, driving its concrete implementation globally at speed, with a high quality of advisory and execution. We are present across 17 countries with committed, highly qualified teams. We leverage technology, data, sourcing, security and investment allocation in a global way, but also achieve economies of scale and synergies when necessary. At AXA Group Operations, we want to be recognized in three fields of action: State-of-the-art Data Technology to drive customer experience State-of-the-art Procurement & Sourcing to drive efficiency and better manage risks High-Performing Global Team for stronger partnerships with AXA entities Where will you be in the organization? The division Group Technology Operations (GTO) aims at designing, developing, and operating Global AXA IT products, delivering them to AXA Entities and the AXA Group, at the right level of quality of service and cost and aligned with business-driven priorities. Its missions can be summarized in four main activities: global product delivery, global product portfolio management, day-to-day operations management, and entities proximity management. The department / team You will join the Business and Data Global Products department, in the AI Products team, which encompasses a large range of solutions and services to support the GenAI needs of AXA: Secure GPT Web: Internal chatbot that offers secure and compliant access to Generative AI solutions for AXA employees Secure GPT Model Hub: Internal platform that offers secure and compliant access to vary LLM to business applications About the job Job purpose Secure GPT is an internal AXA service that provides secure and compliant access to Generative AI solutions for AXA employees. It enables employees to generate, summarize, translate, reformulate, and correct text and codes for daily tasks related to insurance work. The service ensures data sovereignty and protects against intellectual property loss while being compliant with all relevant labor regulations. Secure GPT is currently available for 150 000 collaborators at AXA. The purpose of this internship is to work on the development of Secure GPT. The intern will assist the development team in adding new functionalities (JavaScript/NodeJS/NextJS). The aim is to contribute to the growth and success of Secure GPT and enable AXA employees to better perform their daily insurance tasks using AI technologies. The current team is about 10 people, in France and Portugal, working on many aspects to manage operational activities and product development. Main missions Your responsibilities include: Build news functionalities to Secure GPT web interface to improve adoption. Build a backend administrator panel for operations Write documentation on developed features Work in agile mode About you We are looking for someone with the following experience and skills: Experience At least 2 years of IT engineering school Knowledge on AI is a plus Technical skills Javascript development (NodeJS/NextJS/React) Data manipulation Experience with Generative AI (chatGPT, Bard,..) Optional: Kusto query language (Logs Analytics) Soft skills / transversal skills Ability to work independently and look for solutions Curious Reliable Commitment Communicative Rigorous French & English speaker mandatory What we offer We bring together the expertise, cultural diversity and creativity of over 8,000 employees worldwide and we’re committed to equal opportunities in all aspects of employment (gender, LGBT+, disabled persons, or people of different origins) and to promoting Diversity & Inclusion by creating a work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect, and where individual differences are valued.

data.title: Apprenticeship | Reporting Analyst / Developer
data.description: YOUR WORK ENVIRONMENT Why AXA? At AXA, we work together every day for human progress by protecting what matters. It’s a foundation of our actions, our strategy, and the way we collaborate across the Group. Every day, we contribute to human progress in a way that is practical, responsible, and meaningful, creating a shared sense of direction, commitment, and collective impact that connects people across teams, countries, and roles. As one of the world’s leading insurers in the protection of property, people, and assets, AXA brings together 154,000 employees and contributors across 50 countries, serving over 95 million customers worldwide. As a responsible corporate citizen, AXA is deeply engaged in social and environmental initiatives and actively promotes an inclusive culture where every voice matters, differences are valued, and everyone is encouraged to grow through our strategy Care and Dare. About AXA Group Headquarters (GIE AXA) AXA Group Headquarters (GIE AXA) brings together the Group’s corporate functions and plays a central role in shaping and driving AXA’s global strategy. It supports subsidiaries worldwide by ensuring strategic alignment, governance, operational and technical excellence, consistency of standards, and the sharing of best practices across the organization. With nearly 1,000 employees representing 45 nationalities, the headquarters embodies AXA’s strong international culture and offers a dynamic, collaborative, and intellectually stimulating environment: where global impact meets everyday teamwork. If these ambitions resonate with you, come and help shape the future of protection with us! AXA EssentiALL combines about twenty global experts with dedicated local teams in each market where we do business. At end-2024, this initiative protected over 17 million clients in 20+ countries in emerging economies as well as European markets contributing to financial inclusion and sustainable development through a profitable business approach. Project overview AXA EssentiALL's Data team is seeking an intern with strong statistics skills for a one-year reporting role. The main focus is to improve performance tools for markets, support strategic data projects, and assist in product data research. The candidate will work with stakeholders to create clear reports and dashboards, enhancing understanding of the business portfolio and strategy. YOUR ROLE AND RESPONSABILITIES: What You’ll Do Business reporting tools and data analytics projects Maintain, adapt, and enhance business dashboards and analytical tools of emerging markets under the guidance of the data and analytics manager. Understand multiple data structures and sources to lead the development and implementation of business intelligence solutions for mature markets overall consolidation process (bi-annual performance exercise, StratPlan and customer centricity annual exercises). Ensures that the data model is operationally accurate and appropriate throughout data management processes, including internal and external data collection, data transformation, and data quality for audit purposes. data.description: About AXA As a world-leading insurance company, we act for human progress by protecting what matters. With 153,000 employees in 54 countries working for 105 million customers, we’ve created a truly dynamic and vibrant community. Inclusion and diversity link closely with our values, and together we’re nurturing a culture of respect, for each other, for our customers and the communities around us. Join AXA and you’ll feel like you belong, are included and can thrive. You’ll be able to shape the way you work and truly grow your potential as you seek out new opportunities, push boundaries and benefit people in critical moments of their lives. This is your chance to build the tomorrow you want. Know you can. About the entity AXA is becoming a sustainable tech-led company and at AXA Group Operations we are one of the major catalysts for this transformation.  We set the tone by triggering and empowering the evolution of our insurance business model through technology and innovation, driving its concrete implementation globally at speed, with a high quality of advisory and execution. We are present across 17 countries with committed, highly qualified teams. We leverage technology, data, sourcing, security and investment allocation in a global way, but also achieve economies of scale and synergies when necessary. At AXA Group Operations, we want to be recognized in three fields of action: State-of-the-art Data Technology to drive customer experience State-of-the-art Procurement & Sourcing to drive efficiency and better manage risks High-Performing Global Team for stronger partnerships with AXA entities Where will you be in the organization? The division Group Technology Operations (GTO) aims at designing, developing, and operating Global AXA IT products, delivering them to AXA Entities and the AXA Group, at the right level of quality of service and cost and aligned with business-driven priorities. Its missions can be summarized in four main activities: global product delivery, global product portfolio management, day-to-day operations management, and entities proximity management. The department / team You will join the Business and Data Global Products department, in the Data, BI & Analytics team, which encompasses a large range of solutions and services to support the Business of AXA, from technical IT4IT tools to enhanced Data capabilities, helping systems to be more reliable and secured.    Our team is composed of 3 Product : Data, BI & Analytics  SHINE platform provides Data capabilities through reporting, analysis, visualization tools Master Data Management (MDM) enhancing Data quality through Data governance  Secure GPT: Internal service that offers secure and compliant access to Generative AI solutions for AXA employees. About the job Job purpose Secure GPT is an internal AXA service that provides secure and compliant access to Generative AI solutions for AXA employees. It enables employees to generate, summarize, translate, reformulate, and correct text and codes for daily tasks related to insurance work. The service ensures data sovereignty and protects against intellectual property loss while being compliant with all relevant labor regulations. Secure GPT is currently available for 150 000 collaborators at AXA. The purpose of this internship is to work on the adoption of Secure GPT, through communication. The intern will be responsible for dealing will all aspects of communication around the product. Facing 200+ entities and 150k users requires to communicate clearly and enough, to avoid most of 1-to-1 contacts. The current team is about 20 people, in France, Spain and Portugal, working on many aspects to manage operational activities and product development. Main missions Your responsibilities include: Communities' management (Teams, Confluence...) Newsletters FAQ and documentation Promotion video generation Communication pack generation Internal customers synchronization Event preparation Product promotion About you We are looking for someone with the following experience and skills: Experience At least 2 years of Business/Communication School Knowledge on AI is a plus Requirements: Strong communication skills, both written and verbal Enthusiastic and eager to learn about product communication and marketing Ability to work effectively in a team environment Basic knowledge of digital marketing and social media platforms Proactive and detail-oriented approach to work Basic IT knowledge, as the understanding of the product and its limitation is key French & English speaker mandatory What we offer We bring together the expertise, cultural diversity and creativity of over 8,000 employees worldwide and we’re committed to equal opportunities in all aspects of employment (gender, LGBT+, disabled persons, or people of different origins) and to promoting Diversity & Inclusion by creating a work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect, and where individual differences are valued.
